# @rantalainen/ytj-api-client

> 标签: JavaScript

## 简介

**YtjApiClient** is a third party api client for NodeJS. It is a wrapper around a SOAP client that has been [automatically generated](https://github.com/dderevjanik/wsdl-tsclient) using the [WSDL schema](https://api.tietopalvelu.ytj.fi/yritystiedot.asmx?W
